title: Sales Support
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.

We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Sales Support (ICT) to join our São Paulo office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support sales team in preparing quotations, proposals, and technical documentation for ICT projects (data center, cabling, networking).
  • Coordinate with vendors, procurement, finance and delivery teams to ensure accurate pricing and solution design.
  • Manage internal approval processes including contract, PO, and invoicing coordination.
  • Track project pipeline and maintain sales documentation.
  • Assist in communication with customers and suppliers in English when required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Telecommunications, IT or related fields.
  • Experience in sales support / commercial operations / ICT industry.
  • Familiar with ICT products such as network equipment, structured cabling, or data center solutions.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Strong coordination and documentation skills.

Employment Type:

  • CLT

Work Model:

  • 100% on-site (São Paulo Office)

title: IT Helpdesk Engineer, Corporate IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.

As a Helpdesk Engineer, you will be responsible for implementing IT operations according to policy, interpret IT related issues on both System and User side to meet corporate requirements, and provide technical support in a fast-paced and demanding environment.

Job Description:

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to end users and ensure the smooth running of computers, network devices and printers
  • Troubleshoot and resolve end user application issues, maintain and update technical support documentation
  • Handle asset management, maintain inventory and liaise with vendors
  • Maintain and monitor office network infrastructure, IT security and antivirus tools
  • Other duties include performing first level troubleshooting and support for scheduled server backups, system monitoring and reports

Job Requirements:

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Sciences, Information Technology or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience operating in a similar role
  • In-depth knowledge of computer hardware, software, and OS (Windows and macOS)
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, IP addressing and LAN technology including switching and routing fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience in Windows server administration and basic knowledge in Linux server administration is a plus
  • Professional Qualification - Microsoft Certified/CCNA is a plus
  • Knowledge of basic setup and configuration of Cisco devices such as firewall, switch, IP phones, wireless controller and access points is a plus
  • Competent at documenting standard operating procedures and knowledge articles
  • Ability to cover after-office hours and weekend support if there are any infrastructure issues or activities
  • Enthusiastic and willing to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Passionate in IT technology and wants to make a difference with technology solutions
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Especialista Azure
description:
Atividades:

• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)

Diferencial desejado:

• Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).

• Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).

• Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).

• Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking).

Qualidade pessoais desejadas:

• Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.

• Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.

• Habilidade de resolução de problemas:

• Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.

• Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.

• Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.

• Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.

• Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.

• Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.

• Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos.

Experiência anterior desejada:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).

Habilidades Técnicas:

- Azure

- AKS

- AZ-104

- AZ-900

- estratégias de migração

- IaC

- Terraform

- Bicep

- On-premises

- SaaS

- Containers

- PaaS

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto

title: Analista Sênior de Inteligência de Oferta com foco em Dados & Analytics

Esse(a) profissional terá papel estratégico no aprofundamento do uso de dados na tomada de decisão, apoiando iniciativas de crescimento, segmentação da base, personalização de ofertas e evolução do negócio. É uma posição com forte interação com a gestão e áreas parceiras, com espaço para autonomia, visão estratégica e protagonismo analítico.

Principais responsabilidade

  • Estruturar e evoluir segmentações de clientes, considerando perfil, comportamento, jornada e potencial de valor.
  • Desenvolver estudos analíticos de comportamento, propensão, ciclo de vida e evolução da base de clientes.
  • Apoiar o desenho de estratégias de oferta x público x canal, transformando dados em recomendações claras e acionáveis para o negócio.
  • Construir, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores, painéis e dashboards que suportem decisões estratégicas e o monitoramento de performance.
  • Traduzir análises complexas em insights acionáveis, com comunicação clara e storytelling orientado a dados.
  • Atuar como ponto focal analítico junto às áreas de marketing, produtos, tecnologia e projetos.
  • Estruturar e formalizar demandas de dados e análises, garantindo alinhamento entre as necessidades do negócio e os times técnicos.
  • Apoiar a coordenação por meio da elaboração de análises pontuais e estudos estratégicos, respondendo a demandas específicas do negócio, como definição de públicos prioritários, avaliação de oportunidades de campanha, análise de variações de performance e simulações de cenários.
  • Acompanhar e mensurar os resultados das ações implementadas, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua e evolução da estratégia.
  • Atuar com senso de dono, zelando pela qualidade dos dados, consistência das análises e impacto gerado.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida em Inteligência de Dados, BI ou Analytics, com atuação próxima às áreas de negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, aliada a visão estratégica e orientação a resultados.
  • Vivência em segmentação de clientes, análises comportamentais e mensuração de performance.
  • Conhecimento em produtos de investimentos ou mercado financeiro.
  • Experiência com SQL e ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar dados em insights claros, relevantes e acionáveis para diferentes públicos.
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado e com autonomia para conduzir análises de ponta a ponta.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com dados de canais digitais e análise de comportamento online.
  • Vivência na interação com áreas de Tecnologia e Projetos, incluindo definição de requisitos e acompanhamento de demandas.
  • Atuação em ambientes orientados a growth ou cultura data-driven.

Cursos e conhecimentos desejados

  • Formação complementar em estatística aplicada, análise de comportamento do cliente ou segmentação de bases.
  • Cursos voltados a visualização de dados e storytelling com dados.
  • Conhecimentos em modelos de propensão, clusterização ou análises preditivas por meio de experiência prática.
  • Capacitação em dados e métricas de canais digitais (ex.: web analytics, comportamento online, funil digital).
  • Cursos e certificações relacionados a mercado financeiro ou produtos de investimentos como diferencial.

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact ! Quais serão suas atividades; Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

title: Credit Risk Underwriter - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Credit Underwriting & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end underwriting process for the company’s credit products, ensuring applications are reviewed, analyzed, and documented according to internal credit policies.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of borrower information, credit bureau data, financial capacity, and behavioral indicators to support sound approve/reject decisions.
  • Prepare structured credit memos and recommendation reports for internal review and committee discussion.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and auditability across all underwriting decisions.

Credit Policy Implementation & Continuous Improvement

  • Translate credit policies and guidelines into practical underwriting workflows, checklists, and decision frameworks.
  • Support the implementation of new credit products from launch phase to scale, ensuring underwriting processes are robust, efficient, and aligned with risk appetite.
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in underwriting procedures and propose enhancements.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and provide feedback loops to refine credit criteria, eligibility rules, and approval standards.

Portfolio Analytics & Credit Policy Interpretation

  • Interpret the portfolio analytics outputs produced by the Data AVP (vintage analysis, PD/LGD back testing, score migration matrices) and translate them into actionable credit policy adjustment proposals: cutoff recalibration, rate tier shifts, eligibility criteria refinements.
  • Prepare quarterly portfolio review packages for the credit committee, including performance summaries, model monitoring metrics, and recommended policy actions with supporting analysis.
  • Monitor portfolio concentration risk, sector exposure, and early warning indicators on an ongoing basis. Escalate emerging risks and propose mitigation actions to Credit Risk AVP.

Portfolio Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track key credit performance indicators, including approval rates, delinquency trends, and early warning signals.
  • Prepare recurring portfolio analysis and performance reports for internal stakeholders and credit committees.
  • Escalate emerging risks and recommend corrective actions when needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Risk, Data, Operations, and Business teams to ensure smooth execution of credit processes.
  • Support documentation and governance standards related to underwriting and credit decisioning.
  • Contribute to building the company’s credit knowledge base as new products and processes are developed.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of experience in credit underwriting, credit policy, or credit risk analysis within a fintech, finance company, SCD, or bank.
  • Proven hands-on experience leading underwriting processes for a structured credit product. Experience with secured lending / regulated lending products is a strong plus.
  • Strong knowledge of credit analysis fundamentals: bureau interpretation, income and affordability assessment, risk segmentation, decision documentation and regulatory requirements.
  • Solid Excel skills and comfort working with data to support credit decisions and portfolio monitoring. Exposure to BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is a plus.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

As a CMDB ServiceNow Technical Consultant you will focus on designing, implementing, and optimizing CMDB solutions, ensuring accurate configuration data and supporting IT service management processes.

  • Design, implement, and maintain ServiceNow CMDB architecture and data models.
  • Configure and support ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, and ITOM integrations.
  • Ensure CMDB data quality, governance, and compliance .
  • Develop custom scripts, business rules, and integrations within ServiceNow.
  • Support CI lifecycle management and relationship mapping.
  • Collaborate with ITSM, ITOM , and infrastructure teams.
  • Troubleshoot CMDB and discovery issues.
  • Document technical solutions and best practices.
  • Participate in client workshops and requirement gathering.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations for CMDB optimization.
  • Support CMDB audits and health dashboards .

Candidate Profile

  • 5 years of experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, and ITOM .
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – CMDB.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • CI Class Manager
  • Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE)
  • Service Mapping
  • MID Server configuration
  • Proficiency in: JavaScript, ServiceNow scripting (Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts).
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with external systems (REST/SOAP APIs).
  • Strong understanding of ITIL framework.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken).

Bonus Skills

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with ServiceNow CSDM .

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Being first is in our nature. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company – where you will not be just an employee but a family member of the organization.

A career at Netcore is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

What’s in it for you?

  • Immense growth, continuous learning and connect with the top-notch brands
  • Work with some of the most innovative brains
  • Opportunity to explore the Brazil market with your entrepreneurial mindset
  • Open culture where your creative bug gets activated

If this sounds like a company you would like to be a part of, and a role you would thrive in, please don’t hold back from applying! We need your unique perspective for our continued innovation and success!

So let’s converse! Our inquisitive nature is all keen to know more about you.

description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
  • Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;

Diferencial

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: Network Engineer- 12x36
description:
We are looking for a Network Engineer in Londrina!

Must have:

  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Cisco Firepower (configuration, troubleshooting, policy management)
  • Palo Alto firewalls (security policies, VPNs, threat prevention)
  • Cisco routers and switches (routing, switching, VLAN, VxLAN, high availability)
  • Solid understanding of:
  • DNS management and IP addressing
  • Wi-Fi troubleshooting and optimization
  • Ability to:
  • Perform hardware support, including RMA processes
  • Use network monitoring tools for proactive issue resolution
  • Mastery of DNS concepts and practices, including:reservation and management of public and private IP addresses
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Good to know:

  • CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certifications
  • Cloud networking (AWS, Azure, OCI)

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Firewall & Security Management
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco Firepower and Palo Alto firewalls, ensuring compliance with security policies.
  • Implement VPNs, intrusion prevention, and threat mitigation strategies.
  • Routing & Switching
  • Deploy and manage Cisco routers and switches, including VLAN configuration, routing protocols, and network optimization.
  • Ensure high availability and performance of core network infrastructure.
  • Network Services
  • Administer DNS and DHCP services for reliable name resolution and IP management.
  • Maintain accurate IP addressing schemes and documentation.
  • Wireless Networking
  • Provide support for Wi-Fi infrastructure, including troubleshooting connectivity issues and optimizing coverage.
  • Hardware Support
  • Manage RMA processes for defective hardware and coordinate with vendors for timely replacements.
  • Ensure proper installation and maintenance of network hardware.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting
  • Utilize network monitoring tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain detailed network diagrams, configurations, and operational documentation.
  • Adhere to industry best practices and organizational security standards.

title: Network and Systems Administrator
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to grow your career in IT Infrastructure?

We’re looking for a hands‑on, motivated Network & Systems Administrator to support our growing IT environment in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for someone with solid experience who wants to deepen their technical skills, work with modern technologies, and be part of a global, collaborative team.

Job Description

Your Mission: You Will…

  • Support day‑to‑day operations of corporate networks, servers, and IT systems.
  • Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and Wi‑Fi networks across offices and datacenters.
  • Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and infrastructure components.
  • Investigate and resolve IT incidents reported by users, ensuring reliable service delivery.
  • Follow corporate security policies and contribute to maintaining a safe and compliant environment.
  • Assist in IT infrastructure projects, documentation, upgrades, and system improvements.
  • Collaborate with your Team Lead, peers, cross‑functional teams, and external vendors when needed.

Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related discipline is desirable but not essential.
  • Proven experience in network/system administration in a corporate environment.
  • Practical knowledge of routing, switching, Wi‑Fi networks and firewalls.
  • Experience with VPN solutions or ZTNA.
  • VMware or alternative vendor virtualisation experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) – networking/security fundamentals are enough.
  • Good understanding of DNS, user/role‑based access control, and general IT security practices.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and communicate clearly with global teams.
  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken).

You’ll Stand Out If You Have…

  • Certifications such as Cisco/Juniper, Linux Admin, VMware, or Windows Admin.
  • Hands‑on experience with Meraki devices and Wi‑Fi controllers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A proactive, solution‑oriented mindset and willingness to continuously learn.
  • Experience working in a distributed or multinational environment.

Thrive in a Culture That Values…

  • Learning opportunities and support to grow into more advanced responsibilities.
  • A friendly, collaborative team that shares knowledge and works together across regions.
  • A stable environment where you can build long‑term technical expertise.
  • Flexibility, ownership, and trust in managing your work.
  • A respectful and inclusive workplace where your contribution truly matters.

Additional Information

HOW TO APPLY?

Along with your CV, please submit a short motivation letter outlining your experience in network and systems administration or related IT roles. You can add this directly in the “Message to the Hiring Manager” section when applying.

IT INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

You’ll be joining a supportive and experienced team responsible for keeping Playtech’s core systems running smoothly. We work with a variety of technologies, collaborate globally, and value teamwork, reliability, and continuous improvement. It’s a great environment to grow your skills while working on meaningful technical challenges.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome everyone and celebrate diversity across our teams.

title: Senior Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior backend Developer - Java

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live in the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience of the technologies Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: In-house Engineer
description:
Role: In-house Engineer

Global Opportunities

By joining a team of more than 7,000 people operating in over 60 countries, you will be part of an agile network of talented and ambitious individuals. We count on you to engage, connect, and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. Seize the opportunity to learn, create, and develop your potential with us.

About the Field Service Team

You will be part of the Brazil Field Service team. Our department is responsible for providing first-class field service and support 24/7. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and interpersonal skills through diverse and challenging opportunities.

About the Role: In-house Engineer

As our In-house Engineer, you will be part of a highly qualified team and will be responsible for providing technical and commercial support to our customers directly at their sites.

We currently have four openings available.

Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the following locations

or nearby areas:

  • Nova Lima, MG
  • Santa Bárbara, MG
  • Parauapebas, PA
  • Canaã dos Carajás, PA,
  • Belém, PA

Your Responsibilities

  • Work full-time at designated customer sites.
  • Serve as the FLS focal point at the customer’s site.
  • Coordinate the resolution of all open items between FLS and the customer, ensuring effective and timely closure.
  • Provide on-site basic technical and commercial support to assist customers in achieving maximum operational efficiency with their FLS equipment, including filters, thickeners, flotation cells, crushers, HPGRs, and mills.
  • Monitor the customer’s inventory as well as all other key operational aspects to ensure safe and reliable operations.
  • Relay updated technical and commercial information from the customer site to FLS customer support teams.
  • Support the customer and the FLS team during scheduled and emergency maintenance activities at site.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend products, parts, upgrades, and services that best meet customer needs.
  • Ensure the entire sales process aligns with customer requirements,
  • from the initial proposal to final delivery, within the agreed timeframe.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships and communication with customers.
  • Deliver technical and administrative field reports.
  • Maintain and update the CRM system and other control tools.
  • Promote a culture of personal and team/customer safety.
  • Work independently with limited supervision

What You Bring

  • Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the mining industry (desirable).
  • Good working knowledge of parts and maintenance of mining equipment such as Thickeners, Flotation Cells, Filters, HPGRs, Mills and Crushers
  • Intermediate English and/or Spanish (desirable).
  • Availability to reside in or near the cities listed above.
  • Availability to travel when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Solid knowledge of MS Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Bonus program.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Internal and international opportunities to develop your career.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality, promoting an inclusive environment. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees, the stronger our team. In our commitment to equal opportunities and the elimination of prejudice, we ask that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, number of children and photograph from your application materials.

Please note that we will be reviewing applications till March 30th, but the procees is going forward at he same time and can be closed earlier. so please apply as early as possible. Candidates will be contacted by email and phone.

References from unsolicited recruiters or agencies will not be accepted.

All applicants will be required to pass a medical, drug and alcohol test prior to employment.

FLSmidth requires that all individuals have their respective work visas. Otherwise, we will not be able to accept your application.

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining industry – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

Role: In-house Engineer

Oportunidades Globais

Ao se juntar a uma equipe de mais de 7.000 pessoas atuando em mais de 60 países, você fará parte de uma rede ágil de profissionais talentosos e ambiciosos. Contamos com você para se engajar, conectar e colaborar com colegas de todo o mundo. Aproveite a oportunidade para aprender, criar e desenvolver seu potencial conosco.

Você fará parte da equipe de Field Service do Brasil. Nosso departamento é responsável por fornecer serviço de campo e suporte de primeira classe, 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana. Ao se juntar a nós, você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades técnicas e interpessoais por meio de oportunidades diversas e desafiadoras.

Como nosso Residente, você fará parte de uma equipe altamente qualificada e será responsável por fornecer suporte técnico e comercial aos nossos clientes diretamente em suas instalações.

Atualmente temos quatro vagas disponíveis. Os candidatos devem estar baseados ou dispostos a se mudar para uma das seguintes localidades ou regiões próximas:

Nova Lima/MG ou Santa Bárbara/MG ou Parauapebas/PA ou Canaã dos Carajás/PA ou Belém/PA.

Suas Responsabilidades

• Trabalhar em tempo integral em plantas de clientes designadas.

• Atuar como o ponto focal da FLS no site do cliente.

• Coordenar a resolução de todos os temas em aberto entre a FLS e o cliente, garantindo resolução eficaz e dentro do prazo.

• Fornecer suporte técnico e comercial básico para auxiliar os clientes a alcançar máxima eficiência operacional com seus equipamentos FLS, incluindo Filtros, Espessadores, Células de Flotação, Britadores, HPGRs e Moinhos.

• Monitorar o estoque do cliente, bem como todos os demais aspectos operacionais essenciais para garantir confiabilidade e segurança na operação do cliente.

• Apoiar o cliente e a equipe FLS durante atividades de manutenção programadas e emergenciais na planta.

• Identificar, avaliar e recomendar produtos, peças, upgrades e serviços que melhor atendam às necessidades do cliente.

• Garantir que todo o processo de vendas esteja alinhado com os requisitos do cliente, desde a proposta inicial até a entrega final, e dentro do prazo acordado.

• Desenvolver relacionamentos sólidos e comunicação eficaz com os clientes.

• Elaborar nos prazos necessários os relatórios técnicos e administrativos de campo.

• Manter e atualizar o sistema CRM e outras ferramentas de controle.

• Promover uma cultura de segurança pessoal e de equipe/cliente.

• Trabalhar de forma independente com supervisão limitada.

O Que Você Traz

• Curso técnico ou graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou área relacionada.

• Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência na indústria de mineração desejável).

• Bom conhecimento prático de peças e manutenção de equipamentos de mineração como Espessadores, Células de Flotação, Filtros, HPGRs, Moinhos e Britadores.

• Inglês e/ou espanhol intermediário (desejável).

• Disponibilidade para residir nas cidades listadas acima ou em regiões próximas.

• Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário.

• Fortes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

• Sólido conhecimento em MS Office, Outlook e sistemas de CRM.

O Que Oferecemos

• Salário e pacote de benefícios competitivo em relação ao mercado.

• Plano de saúde.

• Vale-refeição.

• Programa de bônus.

• Plano de previdência privada.

• Oportunidades internas e internacionais para desenvolver sua carreira.

Como empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades, a FLS valoriza a diversidade e a equidade, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo. Incentivamos candidatos de todas as origens e perspectivas a se candidatarem — quanto mais diversa for nossa equipe, mais forte ela será. Em nosso compromisso com a igualdade de oportunidades e a eliminação de preconceitos, pedimos que você exclua informações pessoais como idade, etnia, número de filhos e fotografia de seus materiais de candidatura.

Observe que receberemos as candidaturas até 30 de março , porém o processo seguirá em paralelo e poderá ser encerrado antes. Portanto, recomendamos que você se candidate o quanto antes. Os candidatos serão contatados por e-mail e telefone.

Referências de recrutadores ou agências não solicitadas não serão aceitas.

Todos os candidatos deverão passar por exames médicos e testes de drogas e álcool antes da contratação.

A FLSmidth exige que todos os candidatos possuam seus respectivos vistos de trabalho. Caso contrário, não poderemos aceitar sua candidatura.

A FLSmidth é líder no fornecimento de soluções de engenharia, equipamentos e serviços para clientes da indústria de mineração — para mais informações, visite FLSmidth.com/careers .

title: Analista HRBP Sr
description:
Sobre a empresa

E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.

Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.

Sobre a vaga

O Analista HRBP atuará como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio, apoiando líderes em decisões que impulsionem desempenho e alinhamento às prioridades organizacionais. Com abordagem consultiva, trazer visão analítica para temas de pessoas e liderança, fortalecendo capacidades críticas e garantindo que soluções de P&O contribuam diretamente para os resultados das áreas atendidas.

Localidade: São Paulo - SP

Reporta ao: Gerente HRBP

Modelo de trabalho: híbrido

Contamos com você para:

  • Apoiar e influenciar líderes nas decisões de gestão de pessoas, com visão analítica e alinhamento estratégico, atuando como parceiro nas frentes de estrutura, cultura, talentos e mudança. Atuar junto às lideranças na gestão de conflitos, clima, engajamento, desenvolvimento de times e mitigação de riscos trabalhistas.
  • Atuar em parceria com CoEs e DP, garantindo implementação efetiva das iniciativas nas áreas, bem como correta aplicação das políticas, processos e diretrizes corporativas.
  • Apoiar e conduzir ciclos de gestão de desempenho, metas, feedback e planos de desenvolvimento junto às lideranças, além de discussões relacionadas a sucessão, talentos críticos e planos de retenção.
  • Monitorar indicadores (turnover, headcount, orçamento, clima, produtividade etc.), garantindo conformidade, propondo planos de ação e apoiando na construção de análises e apresentações executivas dos temas de pessoas.
  • Liderar a agenda de pessoas em projetos estratégicos das áreas atendidas, assegurando desenho organizacional adequado, planejamento de força de trabalho, mobilização de talentos e implementação sustentável das mudanças.
  • Gestão estratégica do Employee Lifecycle da sua população cliente, atuando de forma ativa e estruturada nas principais etapas da jornada do colaborador — desde atração até desligamento — garantindo qualidade de decisão, experiência consistente e geração de insights para o negócio.

Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:

  • Formação superior concluída em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento ao nível intermediário em Excel é desejável;
  • Inglês ao nível avançado, com habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, é desejável;
  • Experiência prévia na função, atuando com as áreas de Supply Chain, Go to Market e/ou Corporativo

O que nós oferecemos:

Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass e/ou Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale Natal
  • Vale transporte
  • Descontos em produtos

Igualdade de Oportunidades

Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Caxias do Sul - RS

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Service Desk Specialist

title: Technical Customer Support (LATAM)
description:
*Resume MUST be in English

Location: LATAM

Team: Customer Support

Role: Technical Customer Support (LATAM)

Mode: Remote

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

Our Culture

At respond.io , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

Role Description

At Respond.io , Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges

Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: Senior Open Source Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled professional to support the enforcement of internal policies and licensing obligations related to open-source software in PC and server environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, experience with software compliance, and the ability to collaborate across legal, development, and infrastructure teams.

This role involves analyzing complex software systems, identifying third-party components, and ensuring compliance before deployment. The candidate should be comfortable working in enterprise IT environments and have a solid understanding of software distribution in server and desktop ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities:

•Ensure compliance with open-source software policies across PC and server platforms.

•Analyze large-scale codebases and system architectures to identify third-party and open-source components and their licenses.

•Operate software analysis and compliance tools to manage license and security issues prior to product release or deployment.

•Collaborate with legal and technical stakeholders to define compliance strategies and resolve licensing concerns.

•Identify and escalate risks to management and legal teams.

•Prepare and present compliance status reports to stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

•5+ years relevant experience

•Experience with software development or integration in PC and server environments.

•Solid understanding of open-source licenses (e.g., GPL, MIT, Apache).

•Hands-on experience with compliance and security tools such as FOSSA, SonarQube, Snyk, Black Duck , or similar platforms.

•Proficiency in programming languages such as C, Python, Java, and familiarity with tools like Git, Jenkins, Docker, and Maven.

•Experience with operating systems such as Windows Server, Linux, and virtualized environments.

•Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

•A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with attention to detail.

Education:

•Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .

title: Brazil Service Representative
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Brazil Service Representative (Manager Level) to lead and execute product and service operations across the Brazilian market. This role covers end-to-end service management, including offline customer service, technical support, repair network development, and distributor management, with the goal of enhancing customer satisfaction and service excellence in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and execution of product and service operations in Brazil, including offline customer service, technical support, repair services, and distributor management.
  • Establish and manage a local repair service network, including onboarding, supervising, and evaluating authorized service centers.
  • Develop service standards and SOPs, monitor repair quality and turnaround time, and ensure compliance with company quality standards.
  • Oversee offline customer service and technical support activities, including handling customer inquiries, resolving technical issues, providing product training, and managing escalations or complex cases.
  • Develop localized customer service processes to improve overall service efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with distributors and service partners, including partner development, training, and performance evaluation to drive service capability improvement.
  • Collect and analyze service-related data (customer feedback, repair metrics, complaint trends, etc.), and regularly provide service quality reports and improvement recommendations.
  • Drive service process optimization and cost control initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with HQ CED team, Supply Chain, and Sales to ensure timely service resource allocation and issue resolution.
  • Ensure local service operations comply with Brazilian regulations, including consumer protection laws, product safety certification, and data privacy requirements. Establish risk monitoring mechanisms where necessary.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in regional service, after-sales service, or customer service management
  • Experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience building a local service network from scratch (0–1 setup) is a strong plus.

title: Analista de risco de crédito
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando uma pessoa com perfil quantitativo para atuar na área centralizada de Monitoramento de Risco de Crédito do Banco Cooperativo Sicredi, responsável por apoiar a gestão de risco de crédito de um sistema com mais de 100 cooperativas.

Nosso time tem papel crítico na sustentação do ciclo risco → provisão (IFRS 9 / Res. CMN 4.966) → resultado, traduzindo dados e modelos em diagnósticos executivos, insumos para decisões de negócio e direcionamentos.

A posição terá destaque por assumir a esteira de projeções de carteira e provisão, apoiar o orçamento e o stress testing, além de atuar como referência técnica em análises de sensibilidade e estudos quantitativos robustos que conectam risco, rentabilidade e governança.

É uma oportunidade para trabalhar em temas estratégicos, com alta visibilidade, forte interação com áreas de risco, crédito, finanças e com a rede de cooperativas, e com espaço real para construir e elevar o padrão técnico das análises e dos processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir as rotinas de projeções de carteira, provisão e indicadores de risco, garantindo consistência com bases oficiais e premissas aprovadas;
  • Estruturar e executar análises de sensibilidadee cenários (base/estressado/mitigado), traduzindo impactos em provisão e resultado;
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos e artefatos de projeção e simulação (ex.: ECL, migração, vintage, transição de atraso/estágios, comportamento de carteira);
  • Apoiar o ciclo de orçamento do banco e insumos para cooperativas/centrais, conectando premissas de risco e projeções financeiras;
  • Planejar e operacionalizar exercícios de teste de estresse (cenários e simulações), em articulação com as frentes de RAS/ICAAP e governança interna;
  • Evoluir análises de segmentação/clusters e suas bases, suportando leitura por perfil de cooperativa e direcionamento de ações;
  • Produzir materiais executivos e análises para comitês e agendas de gestão (prévia, fechamento, reports gerenciais), com narrativa clara e acionável;
  • Garantir governança técnica dos números (reprodutibilidade, rastreabilidade, documentação, versionamento e controles);
  • Atuar como referência quantitativa do time, apoiando pares em discussões metodológicas, qualidade de dados e melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras (modelagem, crédito, produtos, finanças, centrais/cooperativas) para alinhar premissas, interpretar resultados e propor caminhos de ação.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Ciência de Dados, Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática em análises quantitativas aplicadas a crédito/risco/finanças (modelagem, projeções, simulações, sensibilidade);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise (mínimo: SQL e/ou Python/R, além de Excel avançado; capacidade de automatizar rotinas);
  • Capacidade de estruturar análises end-to-end: definir premissas, tratar dados, modelar, validar e comunicar resultados;
  • Organização e rigor para trabalhar com números oficiais: controle de versões, rastreabilidade e documentação;
  • Comunicação clara para traduzir análises complexas em mensagens objetivas para público não técnico.

Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

  • Experiência com IFRS 9 / ECL e/ou Res. CMN 4.966 (staging, drivers de provisão, PD/LGD/EAD, overlays);
  • Vivência com stress testing, cenários macro, ICAAP/RAS, ou frameworks semelhantes de gestão de risco;
  • Experiência com Power BI (modelagem de dados, DAX, governança de relatórios) e integração com pipelines de dados;
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de segmentação/clustering e análise de portfólio por perfis (ex.: clusters de cooperativas);
  • Experiência em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou consultorias de risco, com interação com áreas de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de engenharia analítica (ex.: Git, ambientes, testes, pipelines, reprodutibilidade).

Informações adicionais

No Centro Administrativo Sicredi (CAS) para as posições nas áreas de negócio adotamos o formato de trabalho híbrido que se consolidou em 3 dias presenciais, na Sede da empresa, localizada na Av. Assis Brasil, 3940, São Sebastião, Porto Alegre/RS e 2 dias em teletrabalho. Nas posições da área Tech adotamos o formato de teletrabalho

No Sicredi você vai ter:

14º e 15º salários fixos;

Participações nos Resultados (conforme a senioridade);

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico sem coparticipação,

Programas de bem-estar com Wellhub (antiga Gympass), Nutrição, Psicologia, Laboral, Massagem, Grupo de corrida e academia local;

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição – com flexibilidade de % nos cartões VA/VR, sem coparticipação;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Seguro de vida,

Previdência Privada até 8% do salário;

Plataforma de Treinamentos – Sicredi Aprende, com diversos cursos;

Carga horária de 40h semanais – Utilizando sistema de banco de horas;

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
Senior AI Developer

Brazil

Senior AI Specialist

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Senior AI Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design the interaction flow between different AI Agents (e.g., Diagnostic Agent triggers Optimization Agent);
  • Code the decision-making logic that interprets real-time data streams and triggers specific AI interventions;
  • Deploy and manage Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) and Neural Network models within Azure;
  • Utilize Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI / Prompt Flow to build conversational or reasoning capabilities for the advisor;
  • Orchestrate the interaction between physics-based models residing in Synapse and the AI layer;
  • Implement MLOps practices for model versioning, retraining, and drift detection;
  • Design and optimize system prompts for LLM-based components of the advisor;
  • Optimize inference latency to ensure real-time recommendations (sub-second response);
  • Expose AI capabilities via secure REST APIs for consumption by the UI/BI layer;
  • Ensure AI models comply with data privacy and security standards.

Essential Skills

  • Strong experience developing AI or machine learning solutions using Python;
  • Advanced knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit learn;
  • Experience deploying and managing machine learning models including Gradient Boosting models such as XGBoost or LightGBM;
  • Hands on experience with Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service or Azure Machine Learning;
  • Experience working with data platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics or Spark;
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel or AutoGen;
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices including model versioning, retraining and monitoring;
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes;
  • Experience developing and exposing REST APIs to integrate AI capabilities into applications;
  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to optimize AI model performance and inference latency.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.
